tiles.displayName: Auditd EXECVE events by target path
Sudo activity by user and host
Recorded terminal activity by host and user

savedSearches.description: Privileged command executions across all monitored Linux hosts.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Auditd and 'Audit Event Type' = EXECVE and 'Audit Target Command' like '/%' | sort -Time | fields -Entity, -'Entity Type', -'Problem Priority', -Label, -'Log Source', Time, 'Host Name (Server)', 'Audit Login UID', 'Audit Effective UID', 'Audit Session ID', 'Audit Event Type', -'Audit Target Command' | fields 'Audit Target Command' | timestats count as logrecords by 'Audit Target Command'

savedSearches.displayName: Sudo activity by user and host
savedSearches.description: Sudo activity by user and host

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'Sudo Command' like '%' | stats count as 'Sudo executions', min(Time) as 'First seen', max(Time) as 'Last seen' by 'Sudo User', 'Host Name (Server)' | sort -'Sudo executions'

'Log Source' = 'com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.tlog-session-raw' | stats count as 'I/O Events', min('TLOG Event Time') as 'Recording Start', max('TLOG Event Time') as 'Recording End' by 'TLOG User', 'TLOG Host' | sort -'Recording End'
'Log Source' = 'com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.tlog-session-raw' | stats distinctcount('TLOG Recording ID') as recordings
'Log Source' = 'com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.tlog-session-raw' | stats count as 'I/O events' by 'TLOG Host' | top limit = 10 'I/O events'

'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'Linux Security Message' like '%sshd%' and 'Linux Security Message' like '%authenticating user%' | sort -Time | fields -Entity, -'Entity Type', -'Problem Priority', -Label, Time, 'Host Name (Server)', 'Linux Security Message', -'Log Source' | fields 'Linux Security Message' | timestats count as logrecords by 'Host Name (Server)'
'Log Source' = 'com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.tlog-session-raw' | stats count as 'I/O events' by 'TLOG User' | top limit = 10 'I/O events'

savedSearches.description: TLOG recordings available for privileged-access investigation and replay.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = 'com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.tlog-session-raw' | stats min('TLOG Event Time') as 'Recording start', max('TLOG Event Time') as 'Recording end', count as 'I/O events' by 'TLOG Host', 'TLOG User', 'TLOG Recording ID', 'TLOG Session ID' | sort -'Recording end'

'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and ('SSH Authentication Method' = publickey or 'Linux Security Message' like '%authenticating user%' or 'Linux Security Message' like '%Failed password%' or 'Linux Security Message' like '%Invalid user%' or 'Linux Security Message' like '%authentication failure%') | eval 'SSH Outcome' = if('SSH Authentication Method' = publickey, Successful, Unsuccessful) | stats count as logrecords by 'SSH Outcome'

savedSearches.description: Who ran which sudo command, on which host, as which target user, and when?

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'Sudo Command' like '%' | sort -Time | fields Time, 'Host Name (Server)', 'Sudo User', 'Sudo Run As User', 'Sudo Command', 'Sudo TTY', 'Sudo Working Directory', -'Entity Type', -Label, -'Log Source', -'Problem Priority', -Entity

savedSearches.description: Successful SSH connections across all monitored Linux hosts.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'SSH Authentication Method' like '%' | fields 'SSH User' | timestats count as logrecords by 'Host Name (Server)'

savedSearches.description: Sudo commands across all monitored Linux hosts.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'Sudo Command' like '%' | sort -Time | fields 'Linux Security Message' | fields -Entity, -'Entity Type', -'Problem Priority', -Label, -'Log Source', Time, 'Host Name (Server)', 'Sudo Command', 'Sudo User', 'Sudo Run As User', 'Sudo TTY' | timestats count as logrecords by 'Sudo User'
'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'Client Coordinates' like '%' | geostats count by 'SSH Source IP', 'Client Host Country', 'Client Host City'

'Log Source' = com.oraclecloud.logging.custom.Syslog and 'SSH Source IP' like '%' | sort -Time | fields -Entity, -'Entity Type', -'Problem Priority', -Label, 'SSH Source IP', -'Log Source' | fields 'SSH Source IP' | fields Time, 'Host Name (Server)', 'SSH User', 'SSH Source Port', 'SSH Authentication Method', 'Client Coordinates', 'Client Host City', 'Client Host Region', 'Client Host Country' | timestats count as logrecords by 'SSH Source IP'
